messages:
Alyssa C: Heads-up re: MarinerHealth — onboarding check-in shows token latency spikes during daily report window (09:00-10:30 PST). Their renewal is in 6 weeks and they flagged UX regressions. Recommend proposing a short pilot: int8 quantized model + regional routing to their dedicated pool for peak hours. Want to sync on risk/rollback and an enablement plan.
Mike S: Thanks — saw the traces, p95 jumps ~450ms -> 1.2s on long prompts. Could be batching inefficiency + large seq lens. int8 swap could cut token cost ~30% and lower tail latency but need eval on hallucination metrics.
Tara R: Agree with Mike. Need a small eval set (50 prompts) and KL/factuality checks. Recommend canary: 5% traffic to quantized variant first, monitor quality delta. If OK, ramp to 30% during 09:00-10:30 window.
Alyssa C: OK — can we prepare the eval and a canary config by EOD Wed? Also want to include routing rule: prefer dedicated-pool-us-west for window, fallback to hosted-lowcost outside window.
Dan V: Renewal note: customer expressed concern about perceived instability. If we can show a 20% latency improvement and no quality regressions, that materially helps renewal. Can we put that in the renewal deck?
Kate P: I can run customer enablement session once pilot is green. Will need a short doc for support triage and a one-pager for their devs with sample prompts and expected latency numbers. Also capture feedback during session.
Mike S: Quick config suggestion (will test):
```
canary: 0.05
routing: if (request.time in [09:00,10:30]) route -> dedicated-pool-us-west else route -> hosted-general
model_variants: [open-model-v2, open-model-v2-int8]
metrics: latent_p95, token_rate, hallucination_score
```
Tara R: For hallucination_score, use our eval harness: run 50 prompts x 3 seeds, compute BLEU+fact-checker. If degradation > 2% notify. Also snapshot outputs for manual review.
km-bot: Metric alert snippet — recent p95 spike observed: 
```
service: mariner-api
p95: 1.18s -> 1.22s
window: 09:05-09:20 PST
requests: 1.2k/min
```
Alyssa C: Thanks km-bot. Plan: 1) Tara + Mike to prepare eval and canary config by Wed EOD; 2) Kate to prep enablement doc + training slot Thurs; 3) Dan to draft renewal bullet with expected improvements. I'll schedule a 30min sync Fri AM to sign off. Assignments ok? :white_check_mark:
Dan V: Ok, I'll draft the renewal slide and include A/B numbers. If we hit the 20% latency improvement we push early incentives in renewals convo.
Tara R: On it — will post eval results as a short gist and add a csv of metrics. If int8 fails thresholds, we'll propose 4-bit qswap experiment instead.
Mike S: I'll run a small load test tomorrow against dedicated-pool-us-west and post logs. Will also push the canary config to staging so Kate can rehearse.
Kate P: Thumbs up. I'll collect 3 customer questions to address in enablement and create the dev one-pager.
Alyssa C: Great — tagging @Dan V for renewal and @Tara R for eval progress. If anyone sees major quality issues during canary, pause routing with this slack command: `/routemgr pause marinerhealth-window`
Mike S: Noted. Adding a small synthetic to catch regressions too.
Alyssa C: Thanks team — this should help salvage renewal and improve their onboarding experience. Will follow up after Fri sync. :rocket:
